    def pt(v, d=(0, 0)):
        return (v[0], v[1]) if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) >= 2 else d
    def plist(v):
        return [(p[0], p[1]) for p in v if isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) >= 2] if isinstance(v, list) else []
    def sgn(x):
        return -1 if x < 0 else (1 if x > 0 else 0)

    me = pt(observation.get("self_position"))

    resources = plist(observation.get("resources"))
    blocked = set(plist(observation.get("obstacles")))
    blocked.update(plist(observation.get("self_path")))
    blocked.update(plist(observation.get("opponent_path")))
    w = observation.get("grid_width", 0) or 0
    h = observation.get("grid_height", 0) or 0
    scores = observation.get("scores", [0, 0]) or [0, 0]

        target = min(resources, key=lambda p: (abs(p[0] - me[0]) + abs(p[1] - me[1]), p[1], p[0]))
    else:
        target = opp if lead <= 0 else ((w - 1 - me[0], h - 1 - me[1]) if w and h else me)

    best = [0, 0]
    best_score = None
    for dx, dy in [(0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (0, -1)]:
        nx, ny = me[0] + dx, me[1] + dy
        sc = -abs(target[0] - nx) - abs(target[1] - ny)
        sc -= 4 if (nx, ny) in blocked else 0
        sc -= 2 if w and (nx < 0 or nx >= w) else 0
        sc -= 2 if h and (ny < 0 or ny >= h) else 0

        sc += 1 if d <= 1 else (0 if d == 2 else -1 if lead < 0 else 0)
        if best_score is None or sc > best_score or (sc == best_score and (dx, dy) < tuple(best)):
            best_score, best = sc, [dx, dy]
    return best
